model_kind: CatBoost binary classifier (monotone in the gap and chroma-novelty features) giving the hazard that a new song has started
runtime_decision: Embedded read-only in the DSP module and evaluated when a quiet gap ends; the novelty calibration scales and threshold in g2_tables.generated.h decide whether the long-term context is reset. The weights are fixed at build time.

training_data.weights_trained_on: joined-song clips (240: 160 Slakh2100-redux train tracks and 80 Groove MIDI train clips, each the end of one song, a gap of digital zero or synthetic pink noise, and the start of another; 21741 rows), 806 Slakh2100-redux train tracks as single songs (25082 rows) and 523 single real recordings (34694 rows)
training_data.single_real_recordings: folds 1 to 4 of MusicNet public-domain recordings (123), GuitarSet (288), Candombe (33) and BRID (79)
training_data.calibration: the novelty scales and threshold were fitted on single tracks only (Slakh2100-redux train 806, Groove MIDI train 303 and the 523 real recordings; 4547 minutes) so that the false-reset rate is 1 per minute; they are stored in g2_tables.generated.h

selection: The model kind and feature families were not reselected; results were reported on the Slakh2100-redux and Groove MIDI validation sets only.

storage.policy: Split thresholds are 8-bit indices into per-feature sorted binary32 border tables, which is exact. Leaves stay binary32. Splits, tree addition order, scale and bias are unchanged.

training_exclusion: The Winterreise HU33 recordings were not used for training or fitting this artifact.
